name: Space Race
description: America's road to the Moon as NASA filmed it, 1958 to 1975: Explorer 1 and Discoverer launches, Freedom 7, Friendship 7 and Aurora 7, Four Days of Gemini 4 and the Gemini VI-VII rendezvous, The Eagle Has Landed, Apollo Digests, Skylab and Apollo-Soyuz, plus David Wolper's The Race for Space and Race for the Moon. Every Saturday at 10:00 am the official Apollo mission films air in order, from Apollo 7 to Apollo 17.
curated: 2026-10-15: about 26 hours of hand-listed 1957-1975 NASA, Air Force and educational space films (one copy of each film, picked from the JSC, avgeeks, Periscope and National Archives uploads) plus an in-order Apollo 7-17 mission-film slot; shuttle-era and ISS videos, 1980s-90s retrospectives, raw silent footage, press-conference tapes, hoax and ancient-astronaut films excluded.
